import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset
open scoped BigOperators

theorem uniformContinuous_three_stage
  {α β γ δ : Type*} [UniformSpace α] [UniformSpace β] [UniformSpace γ] [UniformSpace δ]
  {f : α → β} {g : β → γ} {h : γ → δ}
  (hf : UniformContinuous f) (hg : UniformContinuous g) (hh : UniformContinuous h) :
  UniformContinuous (fun x => h (g (f x))) := by
  have hgf : UniformContinuous (fun x : α => g (f x)) := by
    
    have h1 : UniformContinuous (g ∘ f) := hg.comp hf
    
    exact h1
  
  have h_main : UniformContinuous (fun x : α => h (g (f x))) := by
    
    have h2 : UniformContinuous (h ∘ (fun x : α => g (f x))) := hh.comp hgf
    
    have h3 : (fun x : α => h (g (f x))) = (h ∘ (fun x : α => g (f x))) := by
      funext x
      <;> simp [Function.comp_apply]
      <;> rfl
    
    rw [h3] at *
    exact h2
  
  
  exact h_main
